summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in the run entry point's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src (the venv's editable textual points at a different checkout). Five unrelated async tests in test_call_later.py and test_screens.py fail in this venv because async def tests are not supported; not fixed. Nothing committed.
